findings.evidence: (1) The Vendor reserves the right to engage third-party subcontractors for data processing activities at its sole discretion without prior notice to the Client, and the Client shall have no right to conduct on-site audits or compliance reviews of the Vendor's operational facilities.

(2) Upon termination of this Agreement, the Vendor shall archive all operational data and records in a secure repository for indefinite historical analysis and business intelligence purposes, maintaining such records permanently unless otherwise agreed in a separate commercial amendment.
